name: @aura/connected-environment
description: AURA Connected Environment — the platform's execution layer. Every external system (CLI, cloud, design, productivity, AI, browser) is modelled as a live execution node with identity, capabilities, health, permissions and telemetry. Prompt Intelligence enriches a request into an engineering brief, the Mission Planner turns it into a dependency graph of tasks, the Orchestrator schedules them in parallel waves onto specialist agents, and the Environment Manager binds each task to a node that actually provides the required capability. The package is pure domain logic — every side effect (process execution, HTTP, auth) is injected by the host through the Transport interface.
